title: Gas-fired appliances.
officialText:
Gas-fired appliances, regardless of btu per hour input, shall be located in an enclosure in accordance
with Section 509 of the New York City Building Code.
Exception: Gas-fired direct vented appliances with a 350,000 btu per hour input or less may be installed in a nonfire rated enclosure.
